query: WITH ActiveHCMJobs AS (SELECT REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(employer_name), ' [0-9]+$', '') AS standardized_establishment, total_wage AS effective_wage FROM estishraf_llm_jobs_info_v3_impala    WHERE  job_sector = 'حكومي' AND is_active_job = 1 AND total_wage BETWEEN 100 AND 600000), WageSummary AS (SELECT standardized_establishment, AVG(effective_wage) AS avg_wage FROM ActiveHCMJobs GROUP BY standardized_establishment    HAVING COUNT(effective_wage) >= 10) SELECT * FROM WageSummary ORDER BY avg_wage DESC LIMIT 100
raw_question: ماهي أعلى الجهات حكومية بمتوسط الراتب؟
